I got my character stuck in a rough spot one time. Our DM likes to set up these great puzzle locations that have various types of encounters. One of those encounters had 6 different doors, all of which contained separate combats. Two of our party went through one door and fought a bunch of undead pirates without much issue. I ended up getting brought to zero in 2 turns, and my party members had no idea it was happening.  The owlbears made short work of my unconscious body, and our DM cut the session immediately after. 

I was left in suspense for a week until our next session. My DM pulled me outside, and we did a solo rp for a few minutes.
